in_sanskrit.name: Nandu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Joy, Delight
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nandu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Nandu is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, meaning 'joy' or 'delight'. It is a popular name in Hindu mythology, given to boys born during times of happiness and prosperity.
